faq.title: Before you subscribe.
faq.a1: It's AIDA's billing unit. Each image analysis uses 1 credit. Video uses 10 credits per minute, counting each started minute: a 2 min 30 s video uses 30 credits.
faq.q2: What happens when I run out of credits?
faq.a2: On API Free, calls are refused with HTTP 429 until the next cycle. On paid API plans, usage continues and each credit above the included amount is billed at the plan's overage price. On web platform plans, new analyses are blocked until the next cycle or a plan change.
faq.q3: Do unused credits roll over to the next month?
faq.a3: No. Included credits are valid for the billing cycle in which they were granted and do not accumulate.
faq.a4: Ask the team to cancel using the contact form. The plan won't renew and stays active until the end of the period already paid.
faq.q5: Why is it free for citizens?
faq.a5: Because checking whether an image or video was manipulated shouldn't depend on how much someone can pay. AIDA is funded by the professionals and companies that analyze at volume.
faq.a6: Online payment is being integrated. For now, subscriptions are arranged with the team, who will tell you the available methods. Billing in Brazilian reais requires a Brazilian tax ID (CPF or CNPJ) and billing address.
